# phb Paper Honeycomb Board (Quinocycle Sdn Bhd)

> Paper honeycomb board manufacturer in Balakong, Selangor, Malaysia. Honeycomb boards, boxes, crates, pallets, and panels — ISPM-15 exempt, 100% recyclable, up to 80% lighter than wood. Serving Kuala Lumpur, Klang Valley, Johor Bahru, Singapore, and export markets.

phb (Quinocycle Sdn Bhd, SSM 202001029919) engineers hexagonal-core kraft paper honeycomb into pallets, heavy-duty boxes/crates, protective packaging, and structural panels. Key facts: a honeycomb pallet weighs ~5kg vs ~25kg for plywood (up to 80% lighter), saving ~$90 per pallet at typical $4.50/kg air freight rates; paper packaging is biologically inert and fully ISPM-15 exempt (no fumigation, heat treatment, or stamps); the material is 100% curbside recyclable. Contact: WhatsApp +6016-891 6381, phone +603-8962 6381, email sales@quinocycle.com. Address: No.13, Jalan Taming P/1, Taming Jaya, 43300 Balakong, Selangor, Malaysia. Hours: Mon–Fri 9am–5pm, Sat 9am–1pm.
